shift_rotated_bboxes: shift rotated bounding boxes by a given x,y offset using shift_rbboxes
shift_predictions_to_original_image: shift detection predictions from image patches back to the original large image coordinates
merge_patch_results_by_nms: merge patch detection results using batched NMS after shifting predictions to original image coordinates
review_shift_predictions: review the shift_predictions function that handles both horizontal and rotated bounding box shifting
review_merge_results_by_nms: review the merge_results_by_nms function that shifts and merges patch results with NMS
